svg.text: AEM Master SCR and Event Workflow Diagram
Audit Engagement Management (AEM) — aligned to MDS-200 v0.8 and UID-200 v0.5
Version 0.2 | MDS-200 v0.8 / UID-200 v0.5 Alignment Draft
Date: 11 August 2026
Primary purpose: show where users go and what major events occur
ENGAGEMENT SOURCE
Approved IAP Item OR Authorized Unplanned Engagement
Source authority and related records are preserved before activation.
1. ENGAGEMENT FOUNDATION
Authorize, define, assign, issue, and establish the stable engagement record
SCR-210
Audit Engagements Workspace
WORKSPACE
Open AEM; search, filter, sort, and prioritize authorized engagements.
View My Tasks, due dates, blockers, high-risk matters, and recent activity.
Start Create / Activate Engagement or open an existing engagement.
Export or print authorized registers and work queues.
SCR-211
Create / Activate Audit Engagement
TRANSACTION
Choose approved IAP source or authorized unplanned-engagement basis.
Record authority reference, directing or requesting authority, and date received.
Save draft, validate required authority, activate, or cancel.
Preserve source record and authorization decision.
SCR-212
Define Engagement Scope
TRANSACTION
Select one Office, one or more Audit Areas, and applicable Audit Focuses.
Document objectives, boundaries, exclusions, and intended coverage.
Validate Office → Audit Area → Audit Focus integrity.
Save, revise, or return the scope for correction.
SCR-213
Assign Audit Team
TRANSACTION
Assign engagement roles, authority, effective dates, and responsibilities.
Check competency, availability, workload, and conflict declarations.
Reassign or replace members with reason and approval.
Preserve complete assignment history.
SCR-214
Prepare Audit Engagement Order
CONTROLLED DOC
Prepare and save the AEO draft.
Submit, review, return for correction, approve, and issue.
Amend only through controlled versioning and authority.
Preserve recipients, issuance date, and superseding relationships.
SCR-220
Audit Engagement Details
APPROVED ANCHOR
Serve as the stable engagement record and lifecycle-navigation center.
Show Office, scope, authority, team, phase, status, schedule, priority, and confidentiality.
Monitor planning-package readiness, KPIs, progress, blockers, due work, and related records.
Open Planning, Conferences, Execution, Issues, AFRs, Reports, Completion & Transfer, and Activity.
Hold, resume, or update authorized summary information.
2. PLANNING, CONFERENCES & EXECUTION
Plan the engagement, conduct conferences, execute procedures, document work, and manage evidence
SCR-221
Engagement Planning Workspace
WORKSPACE
Coordinate Preliminary Survey, Process Flow Documentation, AEP + KPIs, Risk Matrix, Audit Programs, and planning readiness.
Track review, approval, communication, amendments, outstanding planning requirements, and blockers.
Open SCR-222 / SCR-223 / SCR-224; Process Flow and Risk Matrix remain controlled planning artifacts under SCR-221.
SCR-222
Prepare Audit Engagement Plan
CONTROLLED DOC
Prepare AEP and engagement KPIs: objectives, scope, criteria framework, methodology, evidence, resources, milestones, and schedule.
Submit, review, return, approve, communicate, version, and amend with documented reason and effective date.
Preserve the approved baseline and management communication; reapprove material changes before or during execution.
SCR-223
Audit Program
WORKSPACE / DOC
Manage one or more Audit Programs by applicable Audit Area and link approved Risk Matrix items / risk statements.
Maintain Audit Information: description, audit type / period, objectives, criteria, and controlled version.
Maintain Detailed Procedures: Process, Procedure, Persons Responsible, planned Man-days, Working Paper Reference, review, and approval.
SCR-224
Audit Procedure Details
DETAILS
Add and assign one procedure; preserve source Risk Matrix Item, Process, audit method, purpose, and expected evidence.
Record person responsible, planned Man-days, Working Paper Reference, due date, results, conclusion, and review.
Link Fieldwork Records and Audit Evidence; create an Audit Issue when results indicate a preliminary matter.
SCR-225
Conference Management
WORKSPACE
Schedule Entry or Exit Conference; set venue, mode, agenda, and participants.
Prepare briefing paper; record attendance, notes, minutes, agreements, requests, and actions.
Record authorized waiver, reason, alternative procedure, approval, and follow-up.
SCR-226
Audit Execution Workspace
WORKSPACE
Manage fieldwork, procedures, tasks, evidence, Review Notes, and execution blockers.
Monitor schedule, effort, procedure completion, evidence sufficiency, unresolved issues, and expected reporting date.
Approve or route controlled changes; escalate overdue or high-risk matters.
Open Fieldwork, Working Papers, Evidence Management, or Create Audit Issue.
SCR-227
Fieldwork Record
DETAILS / TRANSACTION
Create interviews, inquiries, observations, walkthroughs, inspections, meetings, and field notes.
Record persons, facts, dates, sources, and supporting documents.
Link to procedure, Working Paper, and evidence; finalize or version the record.
Create an Audit Issue from fieldwork results.
SCR-228
Working Papers Workspace
WORKSPACE / DETAILS
Create, index, prepare, cross-reference, submit, review, clear, approve, version, and lock Working Papers.
Link procedures, Fieldwork Records, evidence, issues, findings, conclusions, and review notes.
Identify evidence gaps and create additional Evidence Requests.
Create an Audit Issue from documented work.
SCR-229
Audit Evidence Management
LATEST BASELINE
Identify an evidence need; create / issue an Evidence Request or register evidence obtained directly through authorized audit work.
Track request acknowledgment, partial / complete submission, overdue condition, extension, escalation, fulfillment, cancellation, or closure.
Register authoritative evidence with source, custodian, acquisition method / form, and related objective / criterion / control / risk.
Assess sufficiency contribution, appropriateness, relevance, reliability / competence, accuracy / completeness, corroboration / contradiction.
Assess authenticity, integrity, confidentiality, limitations and access; accept, limit, request more, reject, supersede, or mark duplicate.
Link evidence to Procedures, Fieldwork, Working Papers, Issues, AFRs and Reports; preserve source, assessment, version, access, and audit trail.
3. ISSUES, AFR & MANAGEMENT COMMENT
Identify and dispose Audit Issues, develop AFRs, obtain Management Comments, and prepare Auditor’s Rejoinders
SCR-230
Audit Issues Workspace
APPROVED ANCHOR
View, search, filter, prioritize, age, and monitor all preliminary Audit Issues.
Identify unresolved, overdue, high-significance, returned, or blocked issues.
Create a new issue or open Audit Issue Details.
SCR-231
Create Audit Issue
TRANSACTION
Create from Execution Workspace, procedure, Fieldwork Record, Working Paper, evidence, or Issues Workspace.
Inherit engagement, Office, Audit Area, Audit Focus, procedure, source links, and Evidence IDs.
Record title, observed matter, initial significance, owner, and attachments; save draft or create.
SCR-232
Audit Issue Details
DETAILS / DECISION
Analyze, assign, review, add evidence and Working Papers, and resolve Review Notes.
Record disposition and rationale: merge, resolve during audit, retain as observation, refer, or close without finding.
Convert to AFR or escalate urgent/significant matter to an Interim Audit Report.
Preserve source, disposition, conversion authority, and complete history.
SCR-240
Audit Finding and Recommendation Details
APPROVED ANCHOR
Develop Criteria, Condition, Conclusion, Cause, Significance / Effect / Risk, and Recommendation.
Link accepted evidence, Working Papers, procedure, issue, and source records.
Save, review, return, approve, issue for Management Comment, finalize, amend, or supersede.
Control report inclusion; CMS receives only formally issued recommendations and authoritative source references.
SCR-241
Management Comment Workspace
WORKSPACE
Monitor issued AFRs, due dates, extensions, Management Comment submissions, Auditor’s Rejoinders, and exceptions.
Identify late, no-response, incomplete, returned, or escalated cases.
Open Management Comment or Auditor’s Rejoinder transactions; track late, revised, supplemental, or no-response cases.
SCR-242
Submit Management Comment
TRANSACTION
Save draft, submit, preserve attachments, and revise only when authorized.
Record agreement / disagreement, position, explanation, supporting documents, and optional intended corrective action within the comment.
Preserve original, late, revised, supplemental, or replacement submissions as separate controlled versions.
SCR-243
Reserved
RESERVED
Reserved for a future justified AEM screen; no primary AEM workflow shall depend on this Screen ID.
Formal Action Plan, responsible parties, target dates, and implementation status belong to CMS after authorized report issuance.
Do not create, edit, or monitor formal post-report Action Plans in AEM.
SCR-244
Prepare Auditor’s Rejoinder
CONTROLLED RESPONSE
Evaluate the applicable Management Comment and supporting documents against the AFR and accepted evidence.
Record evaluation, conclusion, effect on the finding / recommendation, unresolved matters, and required revision if any.
Prepare, review, approve, finalize, and preserve the Auditor’s Rejoinder and its source links.
Management Comment → Auditor’s Rejoinder (SCR-243 reserved)
4. REPORTING, CMS TRANSFER, COMPLETION, AND CLOSURE
Communicate urgent matters, assemble reports, control distribution, transfer monitoring records, and close the engagement
SCR-250
Audit Reporting Workspace
WORKSPACE
Manage Interim, Draft, and Final Reports, report assembly, source traceability, quality review, issuance, and distribution.
Monitor report status, review notes, approved content, due dates, and authorized recipients.
Open Interim, Draft, Final, or Distribution records.
SCR-251
Interim Audit Report
CONTROLLED DOC
Prepare urgent/significant communication from an Audit Issue or AFR.
Link evidence, Working Papers, impact, recommendation, recipients, and required action.
Review, approve, issue, record acknowledgment, and link the matter to the Final Audit Report.
SCR-252
Draft Audit Report
CONTROLLED DOC
Generate or compile authorized report content and source references.
Include authorized AFRs, Management Comments, Auditor’s Rejoinders, recommendations, and applicable prior monitoring information.
Edit, submit, review, resolve review notes, and approve the draft.
SCR-253
Final Audit Report
CONTROLLED DOC
Finalize from the approved draft; approve and issue the authoritative report.
Preserve version, issue date, authority, and source traceability.
Amend or supersede only through controlled authority and versioning.
SCR-254
Report Distribution
REGISTER / TRANSACTION
Record IAU Head distribution recommendation and LCE or Presiding Officer decision.
Record authorized recipients, delivery method, transmittal, sent date, acknowledgment, and status.
Reconcile failed delivery, correction, or additional authorized recipient.
SCR-260
Engagement Completion and Closure
WORKSPACE
Validate completion assessment, objectives, procedures, Working Papers, evidence sufficiency, issue disposition, reporting, CMS transfer, records, quality, and lessons learned.
Mark the engagement complete or identify outstanding requirements and responsible users.
Open CMS Transfer, Completion Checklist and Assessment, or Close / Reopen.
SCR-261
CMS Transfer and Reconciliation
TRANSFER / RECONCILE
Identify formally issued Audit Recommendations eligible for transfer based on the Final Audit Report or other expressly authorized issuance.
Transfer stable engagement, finding, risk, report, and source identifiers; receive CMS Monitoring ID and acknowledgment.
Reconcile successful, pending, failed, duplicate, corrected, or mismatched records; formal Action Plans are created only in CMS.
SCR-262
Completion Checklist and Assessment
CHECKLIST / ASSESS
Generate the baseline checklist and assess completion, quality, records, reports, transfer, time and effort, and lessons learned.
Record exceptions and support; submit, return for correction, review, and approve.
Confirm closure readiness.
SCR-263
Close / Reopen Engagement
CONTROLLED ACTION
Close with authorized reason, approval, consequence explanation, and audit trail; lock routine editing.
Reopen only with authority and documented reason; restore controlled workflow and preserve prior closure.
Reclose after outstanding work is completed.
EXTERNAL MODULE: CMS
Receives formally issued Audit Recommendations and authoritative source references.
Owns formal Action Plans / implementation monitoring; returns CMS Monitoring ID, acknowledgment, and reconciliation status.
Authorized reopening returns to SCR-220
CROSS-CUTTING EVENTS APPLICABLE THROUGHOUT AEM
Controlled workflow events
Generate record ID; save draft; submit; return; review; approve; issue;
finalize.
Hold / resume; amend; version; withdraw; supersede; cancel; archive;
close / reopen.
Confirm consequence-bearing actions and record reason, authority, date,
and acknowledgment.
Auditability and protection events
Write Activity Log, Audit Trail, status history, workflow history,
approval history, and version history.
Protect approved or issued records from ordinary editing; no
uncontrolled physical deletion.
Preserve source-to-report and source-to-CMS traceability,
confidentiality, custody, and integrity.
Notification, access, and exception events
Notify assignee, reviewer, approver, auditee, management, or authorized
recipient.
Send due, overdue, escalation, issuance, acknowledgment, and transfer
notifications.
Preserve returned, rejected, late, no-response, waived, failed-transfer,
duplicate, blocked, and reopened states.
LEGEND
Engagement foundation
Planning / execution
Issues / AFR / response
Reporting / closure
Primary workflow
Optional / escalation / return flow
Source baseline: MDS-200 v0.8 and UID-200 v0.5; DGM visualizes approved cross-screen flow and major events
Prepared by: Kim V. Lao — Project Manager / IS Lead, CIAS-IS | CIAS-AGIS | Status: Draft for Review
